title: The '80% of German flak crews died' claim
case_note: Bounded extract from The Human Record flak provenance case. It tests source ancestry, repeated claims and nearby-but-different evidence.

claims.text: Roughly 80% of German anti-aircraft crew members died during the Second World War.

sources.label: US Army Medical Department flak casualty chapter

propositions.text: The video carries the 80% German flak-crew mortality claim.
propositions.scope_note: A source carrying a statistic is not evidence that the statistic is historically correct.

propositions.text: The article restates the video's mortality claim in altered form.
propositions.scope_note: The Human Record marks this node as downstream and not independent corroboration.

propositions.text: The automated summary repeats the viral video's claim.
propositions.scope_note: Condensation of the source claim does not create a new witness.

propositions.text: A later video title asserts the figure while its description reportedly calls it untraceable.
propositions.scope_note: The preserved THR record does not treat this as an independent research check.

propositions.text: The official source documents high flak-casualty percentages among Allied aircrew, a different population and measure.
propositions.scope_note: Allied aircrew casualties caused by flak are not the same assertion as mortality among German flak crews.

unknowns.text: The true aggregate mortality rate of German anti-aircraft crews.
Whether an earlier source predating the visible online chain contains the 80% figure.
Whether the figure mutated from a different casualty statistic.
